text_block_list.text:
Victory at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe— 
A round of applause and celebratory cheers 
envelope the venue for the monumental feat 
achieved by <chrname>.

Even the legends who once stood before 
them as high, thick walls now burned with 
fighting spirit as challengers themselves.

On the way to the podium, words of 
blessing were showered by people from all 
over the world—and from Mei Satake, who 
had kept the dream alive.

<chrname> lifts the trophy high. Its weight felt 
like the accumulated weight of all the 
dreams of becoming the world's best.
